dog.description_text: Wanda was found as a stray and is a gentle girl who can be a little shy at first. She takes a little time to warm up, but once she feels comfortable, her sweet and loving nature shines through. Wanda is looking for a patient family who will give her the time and reassurance she needs to blossom into a confident, happy companion.
